observationQuestions: Is the first reading something other than white points on black?
Can one energy passage be followed without a legend into a later filament, boundary, or void?

Before receipts are revealed, can the predicted local control difference and its downstream propagation be distinguished?
Do I want to keep watching for ninety seconds?

passRule: All technical invariants and performance gates must pass; all three final owner questions must be yes. Telemetry alone cannot pass the blind control or aesthetic gates.
stopRule: Stop instead of adding effects if the result still reads as a star field, particle demo, graph, atom model, source-free fog, a camera patched to event changes, or a generic preset with post-hoc provenance.
